n: DFRobot Gravity Offline Language Learning Voice Recognition Sensor (SEN0539)
t: An offline voice module with 121 fixed commands and 17 you can teach it.
steps: Find the DFRobot Gravity voice recognition sensor SEN0539 on the DFRobot site.
Get a host board such as an Arduino Uno, micro:bit, or ESP32.
Wire the module over I2C or UART with 3.3 to 5 V power.
Teach one custom command and test it.
